# Gemini Integration Context Pointer

This current document is guidance, not a state snapshot or an authority source.

- Read health and current kernel state from `cstar_status`.
- Read resumable work context from `cstar_handoff` and the relevant CStar bead.
- If persona context matters, use only the scalar projected by `cstar_status`.
  Persona is style-only, has no default, and grants no execution authority.
- Do not embed host paths, health scores, queue state, or generated priorities in
  this tracked document. Such values become stale immediately.
- Do not initiate remediation, installation, restart, deployment, Git mutation,
  source collection, or other gated work from this pointer.

The generated root manifest may summarize bounded evidence, but it remains
non-authoritative and cannot replace current CStar lifecycle state.
